title: Protective effect of active components of Eucommia ulmoides leaves on gastric ulcers in rats: Involvement of the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Gong, Man; Li, Qiufang; Guo, Hui; Cui, Bingdi; Liu, Yalin; Wang, Ping; Zhu, Huiyu; Liu, Xiaoqian; Dai, Liping; Wang, Zhimin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杜仲叶活性成分对大鼠胃溃疡的保护作用及PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB通路机制，仅涉及分子对接预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Eucommia ulmoides leaves are widely developed as food and medicines in China and Japan. Its main components have anti-inflammatory properties against gastric ulcers. The purpose of this study was to assess the protective role of an extract derived from the active components of Eucommia ulmoides leaves (EUL 50) against a gastric ulcer and analyze the underlying antiulcer mechanism. The main components of EUL 50 were identified using an ultra-performance liquid chromatography (UPLC) method. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were performed to predict the possible mechanism of action of EUL 50 in the treatment of gastric ulcers. The rats received EUL 50 intragastric administration twice a day for 3 days. Hydrochloric acid/ethanol (HCl/EtOH) was utilized to induce gastric ulcers, followed by histopathological and histochemical evaluation of the ulcer tissues and determination of the main oxidative stress parameters and inflammatory cytokines. The expression of PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB pathway-related proteins was measured. Neochlorogenic acid, chlorogenic acid, rutin, and so on were identified as the major components of EUL 50 by UPLC. The prediction results identified the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathway as the main possible protective mechanism against gastric ulcers. Furthermore, in a dose-dependent manner, EUL 50 reduced gastric tissue damage. In addition, the high dose of EUL 50 administration resulted in remarkable reductions in the levels of malondialdehyde (MDA), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin 6 (IL-6), and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) by 22.64%, 42.61%, 57.78%, and 56.51%, respectively, and suppression of the phosphorylation of Akt, p65, IKKalpha, and IkappaBalpha by 60.87%, 67.65, 74.58%, and 59.57%, respectively, and increased the antioxidant enzyme activity. EUL 50 is rich in flavonoids and organic acids that can act on the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathway; as a result, oxidative stress and inflammation are considerably reduced, and gastric ulcers caused by HCl/EtOH are reduced. PRACTICAL APPLICATION: As a medicinal and food substance, Eucommia ulmoides leaves are widely used in the development of health products. EUL 50, a moderately polar part of E. ulmoides leaves, was obtained by extraction and enrichment and was found to have a better protective effect against HCl/EtOH-induced gastric ulcers. This finding can enrich the traditional application of E. ulmoides leaves and provide a basis for their health product development.
abstract_zh: 杜仲叶在中国和日本被广泛开发为食品和药物。其主要成分具有抗胃溃疡的抗炎特性。本研究旨在评估源自杜仲叶活性成分的提取物（EUL 50）对胃溃疡的保护作用，并分析其潜在的抗溃疡机制。采用超高效液相色谱（UPLC）法鉴定了EUL 50的主要成分。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测了EUL 50治疗胃溃疡的可能作用机制。大鼠连续3天每天两次灌胃给予EUL 50。采用盐酸/乙醇（HCl/EtOH）诱导胃溃疡，随后对溃疡组织进行组织病理学和组织化学评估，并测定主要氧化应激参数和炎症细胞因子。检测了PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB通路相关蛋白的表达。通过UPLC鉴定出新绿原酸、绿原酸、芦丁等为EUL 50的主要成分。预测结果确定PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB信号通路为抗胃溃疡的主要可能保护机制。此外，EUL 50以剂量依赖性方式减轻了胃组织损伤。另外，高剂量EUL 50给药使丙二醛（MDA）、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素6（IL-6）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）水平分别显著降低22.64%、42.61%、57.78%和56.51%，并抑制Akt、p65、IKKα和IκBα的磷酸化，分别降低60.87%、67.65%、74.58%和59.57%，同时提高了抗氧化酶活性。EUL 50富含黄酮类和有机酸，可作用于PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB信号通路；从而显著减少氧化应激和炎症，减轻HCl/EtOH引起的胃溃疡。实际应用：作为药食两用物质，杜仲叶广泛用于保健产品开发。EUL 50是杜仲叶的中等极性部分，通过提取和富集获得，并发现其对HCl/EtOH诱导的胃溃疡具有较好的保护作用。这一发现可丰富杜仲叶的传统应用，并为其保健产品开发提供依据。
